breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: A rare inborn error of metabolism disorder, with a highly variable phenotype, typically characterized by neonatal to infancy-onset of seizures, psychomotor delay, and abnormal muscle tone that may include hypo- and/or hypertonia, resulting in generalized weakness, dystonic movements, and/or progressive respiratory distress, associated with severe lactic acidosis and elevated lactate, ketoglutarate and 2-oxoacids in urine. master.definition_en: Craniosynostosis, Philadelphia type is a form of syndromic craniosynostosis, characterized by sagittal/dolichocephalic head shape with a relatively normal facial appearance and complete soft tissue syndactyly of hand and foot. Transmission is autosomal dominant with variable expression of the hand findings, and incomplete penetrance of the sagittal craniosynostosis. Craniosynostosis, Philadelphia type has been suggested to share the same etiology as syndactyly type 1A.

master.definition_en: Chromomycosis is a chronic cutaneous and subcutaneous fungal infection, found mainly in subtropical and tropical areas (in soil and plant debris and transmitted by traumatic inoculation), and characterized clinically by slow growing, verrucous nodules, squamous plaques, or chronic limited lesions which are most commonly found on the lower limbs and which are characterized histologically by the presence of muriform cells. It is caused by dematiaceous fungi, with the main etiological agents being Fonsecaea pedrosoi, Phialophora verrucosa and Cladophialophora carrionii. Rarely, it can be caused by Rhinocladiella aquaspersa.

master.definition_en: Congenital temporomandibular joint ankylosis is a rare maxillofacial disorder characterized by significant reduction in mouth opening (i.e. from a few millimeters to a few centimeters) in the absence of acquired factors (e.g. trauma, infection) contributing to the ankylosis. It is associated with variable degrees of facial dysmorphism (i.e. lateral deviation of the mandible and chin, lower facial asymmetry, retrognathia, micrognathia, dental malocclusion) and patients typically present with feeding and breathing difficulties. Developmental delay, hypotonia, seizures, and additional dysmorphic features (e.g. pectus excavatum, low-set ears, hypoplastic alae nasi) have also been reported.

master.definition_en: Lymphoepithelial-like carcinoma is a rare, malignant epithelial tumor, composed of undifferentiated epithelial cells with dense lymphoid stroma, mimicking lymphoepithelioma. It often shows association with Epstein-Barr virus infection and can develop in various organs, such as the nasopharynx, stomach, skin, breast and lungs, among others. The presenting symptoms, as well as the radiologic features, are usually nonspecific and depend on the affected site and organ.

master.definition_en: Adult-onset distal myopathy due to VCP mutation is a rare, genetic distal myopathy disorder characterized by middle age-onset of distal leg muscle weakness, atrophy in the anterior compartment resulting in foot drop, without proximal or scapular skeletal muscle weakness. Rapidly progressive dementia, Paget disease of bone and hand weakness have been reported. Muscle biopsy shows pronounced myopathic changes with rimmed vacuoles.

master.definition_en: A rare ophthalmic disorder characterized by clinical signs of Graves orbitopathy (i. e. unilateral or bilateral lid retraction, exophthalmos, soft tissue involvement, restrictive myopathy, and/or optic neuropathy) with normal thyroid function and without any signs of hyperthyroidism. Laboratory examination typically reveals low serum levels of thyroid-stimulating hormone receptor autoantibodies.

master.definition_en: Cirrhotic cardiomyopathy is the term used to describe a constellation of features indicative of abnormal heart structure and function in patients with cirrhosis. These include systolic and diastolic dysfunction, electrophysiological changes, and macroscopic and microscopic structural changes.

master.definition_en: Acquired idiopathic sideroblastic anemia is one of a group of disorders known as the myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS) characterized by ineffective haemopoiesis affecting one or more blood cell lineages (myeloid, erythroid or megakaryocytic) leading to peripheral blood cytopenias and an increased risk of developing leukemia. master.definition_en: Pleuro-pericardial cyst is a rare, mostly congenital, pericardium anomaly characterized by the presence of, usually asymptomatic, cysts which are typically located in the right costophrenic angle and are usually incidentally diagnosed. On occasion, it manifests with chest pain, dyspnea, tachycardia, persistent cough or cardiac arrhythmias. The condition is usually benign, but rare complications, such as cardiac tamponade, cardiogenic shock, mitral valve prolapse, hoarseness atrial fibrillation, right ventricular outflow, tract obstruction, spontaneous internal hemorrhage, pulmonary stenosis and sudden death, may occur.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: An myocarditis caused by infection with Corynebacterium diphtheriae.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.definition_en: An autosomal recessive disorder characterized by onset of megaloblastic anemia associated with decreased serum vitamin B12 (cobalamin, Cbl) in infancy or early childhood. Low molecular weight (LMW) proteinuria is frequently present, but sometimes occurs later and is usually mild or subclinical. Patients often present with vague symptoms, including failure to thrive, loss of appetite, fatigue, lethargy, and/or recurrent infections. Some patients may present later in childhood with neurologic abnormalities related to B12 deficiency, such as sensorimotor neuropathy and/or cognitive disturbances.

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

master.definition_en: A food allergy that is an allergy or hypersensitivity to dietary substances from peanuts causing an overreaction of the immune system which in a small percentage of people may lead to severe physical symptoms.
